trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52}.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} (with {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} if the target is {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by the mimic), reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage—or 12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage if the target is {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by the mimic—plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Acid damage.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52}.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entries.name: Mimic
entries: {@i Shape-Shifter Disguised as an Unassuming Object}

In their natural forms, mimics are little more than roaming stomachs, their blobby bodies covered with alien eyes and teeth. They can alter their color, texture, and dimensions to duplicate inanimate objects of their approximate size. Mimics use their disguises as both camouflage and bait. Once victims draw close, mimics strike, lashing out with their sticky pseudopods and toothy mouths. After consuming victims, mimics usually relocate, change form, and await their next meal.
